name: change-details
title: Change details
description: What a kit callback's on<Key>Change(value, details) or onValueChange(value, details) receives for state that is not a UI SDK primitive's (a FilterBar's filters, a FontPicker's family, docstream's task and property editors): UI SDK's ChangeDetails, with reason, event, source (read from the event, programmatic without one), cancel() and canceled. Call the consumer first and write your own state only when the change wasn't canceled.
